In subtractive manufacturing technology, the CNC(Computer Numerical Control) machine is used widely. The drawing robot has a similar mechanism as in operations and it can be used by the user to draw the image they want. The main task of the project is developing an Android app and algorithm for transforming the image into a G-Code file. Also solving the unbalance problem and end-stop button installing.

All basic functions have been completed at the end of the project and included the app building and hardware improvement. The further development is making drawing robots can draw on various platforms by fixing pen holder support. Also, the software can run with other image processing algorithms to overcome the environmental factors by dealing with the image with Computer Vision technology.

The drawing robot contains two main components which are Android app operation and image processing. The 'Drawing Robot Controller' app includes Bluetooth communication functions and image transform functions. The Android app connects the Arduino board to the drawing machine and delivers the command to the robot. From the received G-Code, the robot can analyse G-Code and make an action. For transforming function is used to convert the faster image into a G-Code file. The app can read the G-Code sequence and send it to the drawing robot continuously.

From Figure 2, there are two main methods are used in this method which are Gaussian Blur and dodging images. As shown in the block graph, a Gray Scale image should be prepared first. Then the Gray Scale can be invert and handle with Gaussian Blur. The Gaussian Blur change the clear image with proper degree blur.
